feedback: For routine matched payments I want the system to post the reconciliation automatically without asking me to approve each one.
If the amounts and references match exactly, automatic posting is what I want. Manual approval just slows us down.
Even when a payment looks like an exact match, I do not want it posted to the ledger until someone approves it.
I would rather approve every proposed match than have the system post one incorrectly.
Our team is comfortable with automatic posting for exact matches, but exceptions should stay manual.
Please keep approval required for all matches, including straightforward ones.
